about: Shared engine/plugin fixtures for addressed revision (maestro-playground #160, obsidian-chain-runner #139). Each case is one node's recorded output and the `revisions` value a fork sends for that node; `expect` is the whole output the fork replays, or the refusal status.

cases.name: editing Notes changes Notes, not Pitch
cases.output:
## Pitch
Original pitch.

## Notes
Original notes.

expect.output:
## Pitch
Original pitch.

## Notes
Edited notes.

cases.name: editing both Pitch and Notes keeps both edits
cases.output:
## Pitch
Original pitch.

## Notes
Original notes.

expect.output:
## Pitch
Edited pitch.

## Notes
Edited notes.

cases.name: a Notes body that also appears in Pitch changes only Notes
cases.output:
## Pitch
Shared line.

## Notes
Shared line.

expect.output:
## Pitch
Shared line.

## Notes
Edited notes.

cases.name: editing an empty Notes at the end fills it and keeps Pitch

expect.output:
## Pitch
Original pitch.

## Notes
New notes.

cases.name: editing an empty section between headings fills it in place

expect.output:

New pitch.

## Notes
Original notes.

clearing a section empties it and keeps the headings around it
cases.output:

## Notes
Original notes.

cases.name: a whole-output edit whose was no longer matches is a conflict
a section the output lacks is refused, not appended
a heading the output repeats is refused as ambiguous
two sockets that land on one section are refused

two spellings of one socket are refused
